_comment: Machine-readable registry of printed clauses that are NOT encoded, and the specific DSL primitive
each one needs. Prose narrative lives in cards/ENCODING.md; this file exists so that automated
WHY THIS IS NOT JUST DOCUMENTATION. A partly-encoded card is played by the engine with a clause
silently absent. Any simulation involving it is therefore wrong in a specific, knowable way, and a
play policy trained on those games learns from a card that does not exist. Anything that pilots,
trains on, or reports win rates for a deck must consult this file and either exclude the affected
cards or surface the caveat. `coverage: partial` is the dangerous state -- the card looks encoded.
Fields: card, name, coverage (partial|none), clause (printed text, verbatim), primitive (what is
missing), rulings (SC ruling numbers that constrain what the primitive must do), blocks (other
cards waiting on the same primitive).

missing_primitives.summary: A TargetFilter over a candidate's attached DON!! count.
missing_primitives.detail: instance.attachedDon exists in engine state, but matchesTargetFilter (effects/targeting.ts) has no case for it. givenDonCount is a Condition over a player's total, not a per-candidate filter.

missing_primitives.summary: An action setting a card's BASE power to a literal value.
missing_primitives.detail: setPower applies value - getCardPower(target), i.e. a TOTAL-power set measured at resolution, so it absorbs modifiers already on the target instead of letting them stack on top. setBasePowerFrom has the right arithmetic but requires a source card on the field; copyPower only ever retargets the effect's own card. Rulings #909/#910 add a requirement: the target must span the LEADER (zones ['leader','character']), not just characters.

missing_primitives.summary: An action that makes a player LOSE, to pair with scheduleAtEndOfTurn.
missing_primitives.detail: replacedEvent 'loseGame' exists (OP03-040 Nami) but its only replacement action is winGame. Needs latch semantics too: rulings #878/#954 say the scheduled loss still happens even if the deck climbs back above 0 that turn.

missing_primitives.summary: A Condition over the turn number.
missing_primitives.detail: condition 'turn' only distinguishes your turn from the opponent's. state.turnNumber already exists and is read elsewhere in effects/conditions.ts, so this is a missing Condition variant only.

missing_primitives.summary: A Condition over this turn's event-activation history.
missing_primitives.detail: The engine fires whenYouActivateEvent at activation time but records nothing, so a later activateMain has nothing to test. Ruling #853 constrains it: activating a [Trigger] is NOT activating an Event.

missing_primitives.summary: A DON!!-state restriction on the returnDon cost.
missing_primitives.detail: ReturnDonCost has only amount/minimumAmount, and returnDonCostOptions offers active, rested AND attached DON!! alike, so 'return 8 of your ACTIVE DON!!' cannot be expressed.

missing_primitives.summary: Bind grantKeyword to the card carried by the trigger event.
missing_primitives.detail: The plumbing exists in effects/resolution.ts but is hardcoded to returnToDeck.triggerEventTarget and copyPower.triggerEventAttacker. A filtered target instead becomes a CHOICE among all matching own Characters, which wrongly lets a hand-played body gain the keyword.

missing_primitives.summary: A distinct-card-name constraint on a Condition.
missing_primitives.detail: differentNames exists only on the play/playGrouped Actions. A bare zoneCount eq 5 with a trait filter would wrongly fire on five copies of one card.

missing_primitives.summary: A Condition over this turn's K.O. history.
missing_primitives.detail: MatchState holds no per-turn K.O. log. battledOpponentCharacterOnTurn records a Leader battling a Character, on the attacker, which is a different fact. Ruling #1009 requires it to be cause-agnostic, including the opponent's own effect.

search is the only look-N-then-order-the-remainder verb, and its handler hard-rejects anything but 'hand'/'character' -- it records an action:search:configuration capability issue and enqueues a judge prompt. NOTE this TYPE-CHECKS, because Zone already includes 'life'; it fails only at runtime. Needs face-DOWN placement per ruling #1018.

missing_primitives.summary: A distinct-card-name counting mode for modifyPower's per-card scaling.
missing_primitives.detail: valuePerCardGroup divides the RAW candidate count by `size` (effects/permanent.ts) with no name deduplication, and differentNames exists only on the play/playGrouped Actions. Sibling of distinctNameCountCondition -- same missing concept, a different DSL site (a scaling factor rather than a Condition), so both need building. Rulings #981-#984 pin the semantics exactly: the card itself counts, and a card that has been GRANTED extra names still never counts twice.

missing_primitives.summary: Substring matching for card names, as `match: "includes"` already does for traits.
missing_primitives.detail: leaderName is cardNames(leader).includes(name) -- exact array membership -- and the `name` TargetFilter is exact too. Neither carries the match option LeaderTraitCondition has. NOTE the tempting narrowing is actively WRONG, not merely imprecise: 'if your Leader's card name includes "Ace"' cannot become leaderName: 'Portgas.D.Ace', because 'Ace & Sabo & Luffy' is a real card name containing Ace.

missing_primitives.summary: An action SETTING a card's counter to a literal value.
missing_primitives.detail: modifyCounter is additive -- getCardCounter is (card.counter ?? 0) + getPermanentModifierTotal(..., 'counter'). Rulings #1016 and #1017 between them ban both additive readings: a printed +1000 body must become exactly +2000, and two copies must not stack to +4000. EB01-001 Oden gets away with modifyCounter only because its printed text carries a `counter eq 0` filter this card does not have.

missing_primitives.summary: A modifyPower scaled by the COST of a card a preceding action revealed.
missing_primitives.detail: modifyPower's three scaling fields all count CARDS, not cost points (valuePerPreviousActionTarget, valuePerCardGroup = raw candidates / size, restedDonGroupSize). revealFromLife surfaces its revealed card only through conditionalPlay, which PLAYS it rather than measuring it, and flips it back face-down on a non-match. Both triggers already exist (whenOpponentActivatesEvent, whenBlockerActivated; precedent OP06-048 Zeff). OP15-119 is the ONLY card in the 2,282-card pool printing 'per 1 cost'.

missing_primitives.summary: A source-player for giveDon: the opponent's DON!!, or DON!! bound to the chosen target's owner.
missing_primitives.detail: giveDon (effects/actions.ts) always draws from getPlayer(state, controller); GiveDonAction has no source-player field, and the giveDon COST is narrower still (your own ACTIVE DON!! to your own Leader/Character). Two facets needed: a fixed OPPONENT source, and an OWNER-BOUND source that follows the chosen target's controller. NOTE player: 'any' is WRONG, not approximate -- rulings #856/#864/#868/#874 answer 不能 to cross-side giving while #854/#862/#865/#872 allow both same-side directions, so 'any' encodes a card that does not exist.

missing_primitives.summary: A modifyPower whose magnitude varies PER TARGET by that target's attached DON!! count.
missing_primitives.detail: Every modifyPower scaling hook computes one value applied uniformly: valuePerCardGroup divides a global count, restedDonGroupSize reads the controller's own pool, distributedValues needs authoring-time magnitudes. Sibling of attachedDonTargetFilter in the same way distinctNameCountScaling is of distinctNameCountCondition.

missing_primitives.summary: A declinable opponent DON!! return that branches on whether they complied.
missing_primitives.detail: opponentReturnDon is MANDATORY and records nothing, so 'If they do not, ...' has no predicate. A `choice` with player 'opponent' gets ruling #903 BACKWARDS: at zero DON!! the return branch silently no-ops (amount === 0 returns true) and the else-branch would never fire, where #903 says it does.
